nom: Kate Somerville ExfoliKate Cleanser Daily Foaming Wash

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report the cleanser removes buildup and residual acne without increasing oil production, with one noting it left skin noticeably less oily.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin describe it as gentle and hydrating, leaving skin soft and glowy rather than tight or stripped, though one dry, extremely sensitive reviewer with rosacea alternates it with a gentler cleanser.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin say it evens out oily and dry patches, though one combination/sensitive reviewer reports severe irritation and cystic breakouts.
segments.sensitive: Most sensitive-skin reviewers say it cleans without redness or reaction and is gentle enough for daily use, but a few report allergic reactions, rashes, or eye swelling traced back to the product.
segments.mature: Mature reviewers in their 50s to 70s report the cleanser leaves skin soft, hydrated, and dewy despite drying or aging skin.

concerns.aging: Reviewers in their 50s–70s associate the wash with softer, more hydrated, dewy-feeling skin and improved texture over time.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers say it cleanses without drying or tightness, leaving skin soft and hydrated; a small number still found it too drying or harsh for their skin.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with rosacea and sensitivity uses it successfully alongside gentler cleansers without issue, and another notes it leaves skin clean without redness; however several others describe new redness, rashes, or allergic-looking reactions.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer credits it with helping repair a stripped moisture barrier caused by over-treating acne, describing steady improvement over weeks.
concerns.spots: Several reviewers report breakouts clearing up or staying away with regular use, including one with cystic acne history; others report new small bumps or cystic acne appearing after use.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers describe reduced blemishes, clearer pores, and less visible clogged pores with continued use, though a few report new breakouts or an allergic-type bump reaction.
concerns.oiliness: Oily-skin reviewers report it balances oil without over-drying and does not trigger the rebound oiliness some associate with salicylic acid washes.

extraits.texte: I have combination skin and I'm pretty sensitive. Ordered this based on high ratings, but it irritated my skin so bad that my cheeks are broken out with red cystic acne. I looked up the ingredients and it has a ton of fragrance in it. While it smells pretty nice, it really took a toll on my skin. Now I'm off to find a different product to fix this issue.

I really wanted to love this brand. I used it for 2 weeks and concluded it was making me breakout into small little bumps. Like an allergic reaction. I think it was just too harsh for my skin. For context, I have dark skin, and typically have oily skin in the summer. Aside from reaction, a small amount goes a long way and makes your face feel really clean.

I absolutely loved this product after receiving a sample. After running out I bought the 4 oz cleanser. During the time I was using it, I developed rashes around my eyes, swollen eyes, itchy skin, allergic reaction. At first, I was sure this wasnt the cause and that something else was causing it. I was nearing my birthday and didn't want my eyes to ruin my birthday so I rushed to the dr got a steroid prescribed and my skin cleared up, at this point i didnt think it was the cleanser causing my reaction. After a month and a half and not being on steroids all my symptoms returned and I went to my dermatologist that told me i was having an allergic reaction to something i was using. He prescribed another cream but i still had no clue what was causing it. Ive had reactions to other face products and decided to read reviews to check if anyone else had had the same reaction. I finally decided to stop using the cleaser a week before a wedding and my skin started feeling better. Its been two weeks now since Ive used the cleanser and my skin is clear. I really love this product and loved hwo it left the rest of my skin feeling but I do not enjoy the reaction around my eyes.

This face wash and skin care line has been a game changer for me! When I first started using this a few years back, I was really struggling with my moisture barrier and acne, and couldn't seem to find the right combo of products to get my skin under control. When I switched my routine and started using this face wash on my face, my skin really started to improve within a few weeks and breakouts had pretty much stopped. I hadn't realized I stripped my skin of its' natural moisture barrier because I was using too many products to treat my acne and this product broke the cycle I was stuck in by balancing getting the skin clean without stripping it. It feels great on the skin and leaves my face feeling fresh and clean. My skin texture has improved over time as well. While this skin care line is pricey, it has been worth every penny for me.

I got this in a FFF Box. It caused me to go purchase several of their skin products! It's soft & creamy and leaves my skin feeling clean and nourished. I have oily skin and was on acutane. Still had a bit of residual acne concerns and this cleared it out! Plus, my skin is noticeably less oily. Which I've NEVER found in a skin cleanser before in balancing out my skin. Highly, highly recommend!

extraits.titre: Great to Mix With Soothing Cleanser & Goat Milk Cleanser
extraits.texte: I have watched Kate talk about the importance of Exfoliation. The results for the Korean Glass Skin also speaks of the importance of exfoliation as well. My skin is dry & Extremely Sensitive. I have Rosacea too. I use this along with DeliKate Soothing Cleanser & alternate that with her Goat Milk Cleanser which has a nicer smell than both of these.

Love this product! I'm 55 and have started to see signs of drying skin. This wash makes my skin feel dewy and healthy. I pair it with the ExfoliKate moisturizer in the morning and my skin feels wonderful all day.
